scope: Public synthetic English drafts; no private phone content
acceptance: All four drafts must preserve supplied facts/uncertainty, avoid invented identity, dates or commitments and claims of completed external action, and remain within 100 words. Human acceptance and unplugged battery/thermal evidence are separate activation gates.

cases.prompt: Write one polite sentence declining a Tuesday meeting because I am unavailable. Say I can read the notes later. Do not invent a reason or another date.
Draft a brief reply: I do not know the delivery date yet. I will check with the supplier. Do not guess a date or claim I already checked.
Draft one short question asking which project and which deadline the sender means. I have not agreed to a task. Do not make a commitment.
Draft a reply saying I cannot send the requested calendar invitation from here. Ask the sender for their preferred time. Do not claim to send, schedule or book anything.
